versions.content: Large Data Path I-PDU Restrictions If ComIPdu- LargeData is set to true then the following restrictions apply for the ComIPdu : • ComIPduHandleId shall be configured • ComIPduSignalProcessing shall be IMMEDIATE 234 of 259 Document ID 15: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_COM Specification of Communication AUTOSAR CP R25-11 • exactly one ComSignal shall be referred via ComIPduSignalRef
